name: Manuel
source:
"The sun will dispel all the haze."

Age: Looks 25
Occupation: Director

Quiet and indifferent. A big fan of black coffee. Suffering from amnesia, he chose to learn photography to avoid forgetting, and finally became a director. He has never given up on finding his lost memories back and trying to unravel the secrets hidden in his pocket watch.
